# Native text field of the legacy rename window (CAPIE v1.1 grammar editor capie_v1_ed__rn__legacy,
# window generated by tools/modgen/features/legacy_field.py). ROOT is the player (player_context).
# The opening epoch rn_lg_epoch rises in rn_open_input and rn_cancel_input (hand-written legacy
# effects), so every opening, Apply and Cancel gets a fresh value and a repeated Apply is stale.
# Success: the field's codes pass the unchanged payload validator, fill the input buffer rn_buf
# (rn_inline_copy_payload) and run the usual rn_apply_input with its own target and cooldown checks.
# Without CAPIE (error 10) nothing changes and the window switches to the on-screen keyboard.

rn_lg_field_apply = {
	set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_open = rn_lg_epoch }
	rn_cv1_header = yes
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } NOT = { has_country_flag = rn_input } }
		set_temp_variable = { rn_cv1_err = 12 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		rn_cv1_take_one = yes
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 0 } }
		rn_inline_copy_payload = yes
		rn_cv1_status_clear = yes
		rn_apply_input = yes
	}
	else = {
		rn_cv1_status_record = yes
		if = {
			limit = { check_variable = { temp_var:rn_cv1_err = 10 } }
			set_country_flag = rn_lg_keyboard
		}
	}
}
